## History

Barry was a resident of [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where he kept a flat-bottomed dory for duck shooting. Following [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Diana's visit to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition), Barry drove the girls back home to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. ## Quotes

> "and I can’t prevent her, for her father aids and abets her. She’s always poring over a book. I’m glad she has the prospect of a playmate—perhaps it will take her more out-of-doors."
>
> — Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)

> "Mercy, child, how you have grown! You’re taller than I am, I declare. And you’re ever so much better-looking than you used to be, too. But I dare say you know that without being told."
>
> — Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P18](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0018)

> "I don’t think you are a fit little girl for Diana to associate with. You’d better go home and behave yourself."
>
> — Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P64](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0064)

> "Come in. And this is the little girl you have adopted, I suppose?"
>
> — Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P15](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0015)

> "Diana, you might take Anne out into the garden and show her your flowers. It will be better for you than straining your eyes over that book. She reads entirely too much—"
>
> — Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/barry--diana-barry.md)

Barry is the father of [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and her mother, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) quickly form a close bond in the garden, solemnly swearing eternal friendship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), +7 more_
